name: Koi to Koi Suru Utopia
original_name: 恋と恋するユートピア
source:
This is the debut work for Lovematic. 

Kureha Gakuen, also known as the ‘outdoor baths school’, was formed just last year by the merger of a boys’ school and a girls’ school. The school administration was concerned that the boys and girls were not getting along well, so they decided to create the ‘intergender relations normalization committee’. Kazuya was enlisted into the committee, along with his osananajimi Kaho, class rep Yukina and enthusiastic classmate Nanao, each of whom had a different view on the matter. He figured that since he didn’t have any experience with love relationships himself, it would be best to get closer to the girls.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/03/10/march-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Lovematic的处女作。

红叶学园，也被称为“露天浴场学校”，是去年由一所男校和一所女校合并而成的。校方担心男女学生相处不睦，于是决定成立“异性交往正常化委员会”。和青梅竹马夏帆、班长雪菜以及热情的同学菜菜绪一样，一也被招募进委员会；每个人对此事都有不同看法。他想到自己也没有恋爱经验，觉得最好还是和这些女孩拉近距离。

[来源：[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/03/10/march-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
